items.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Redraw this illustration with clear expressive hand-drawn LINE STRUCTURE and restrained color inside defined forms.
Preserve its square composition: a small floating charcoal lantern upper-left, a muted warm light path diagonally down-right, exactly two thin blank cards at right-center (near ivory, rear ochre), indigo-violet dark abstract background. The lower halves of cards remain in shadow but their contours must remain readable.
PRIMARY CHANGE: establish the drawing BEFORE color. Use clean, deliberate dark colored contour lines with organic variation in thickness and pressure to CLOSE the object silhouettes. Draw lantern roof ridges, metal frame, window corners and support bars as coherent connected structural lines. Both cards have precise thin silhouettes, clear corners, a short visible thickness edge, and an overlap line separating them. Use a few short interior structural accents where metal planes turn, not uniform traced vector strokes. Cards are single sheets, no pages or book spines. Keep TWO cards only.
COLOR: broad restrained matte fills and one or two grouped shadow planes INSIDE these drawn closed regions. Each lantern metal plane and glass window has a calm solid base and sparse purposeful shade; each card face has an uninterrupted warm ivory/ochre base and a simple blue-violet shadow region, its edge remains crisp and drawn. Do not smear texture over the silhouette, erase lower card boundaries or cover the card faces in scratchy patches. A few subtle directional brush marks may follow a form INSIDE its contour, with very low density. Handmade anime illustrative finish with visible line rhythm, not polished 3D or mechanically uniform vector icon.
Remove all the draft's full-canvas scattered brush patches. Background becomes a quiet deep indigo to muted gray-violet restrained gradient with two subtle large color transitions, no scratch streaks, stipple, brush carpet, rocks or scenery. Light path is a low-opacity warm amber glow wedge with soft controlled edge; not a textured ochre paint ribbon or blazing white beam. The lamp windows and two discovered card corners have concentrated pale warm accents. Card lower halves are darkened by a simple clean shadow shape, not hidden under random rough color blobs. All main contour edges remain legible against background. No added objects, people, hands, symbols, text, frame, watermark or UI.
